Experience the perfect blend of pickup truck capability, SUV comfort, and Honda reliability with this 2023 Honda Ridgeline Touring. Designed for drivers who need versatility without sacrificing refinement, the Ridgeline Touring stands apart from traditional trucks by delivering exceptional ride quality, advanced technology, and innovative utility features. Whether you're commuting through Duncan, towing recreational equipment, or exploring Vancouver Island's scenic landscapes, the Ridgeline is ready for every adventure.

Powering the 2023 Ridgeline Touring is Honda's proven 3.5-litre i-VTEC V6 engine, producing an impressive 280 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a smooth 9-speed automatic transmission and Honda's Intelligent Variable Torque Management i-VTM4 all-wheel-drive system, the Ridgeline delivers confident performance in all weather conditions. With a towing capacity of up to 2,268 kg, or 5,000 lbs, this truck is well-equipped for hauling boats, utility trailers, campers, and outdoor gear throughout Vancouver Island and beyond.

Inside, the Touring trim offers a premium and spacious cabin that rivals many luxury SUVs. Enjoy leather-trimmed seating, heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, a heated steering wheel, power-adjustable front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, remote start, keyless entry, and push-button start. The Ridgeline's roomy interior comfortably accommodates five passengers while providing outstanding storage solutions and everyday practicality.

Technology is abundant throughout the Touring model. Features include an 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, Bluetooth connectivity, navigation, wireless smartphone charging, multiple USB charging ports, and a premium audio system that delivers excellent sound quality for every journey.

The Ridgeline's innovative truck bed design continues to set it apart from competitors. The dual-action tailgate allows convenient access from the side or traditional drop-down operation, while the lockable in-bed trunk provides secure weather-resistant storage for tools, luggage, sports equipment, or valuables. The composite truck bed is durable, resistant to dents and corrosion, and designed for years of dependable use.

Honda Sensing technologies help provide confidence behind the wheel with advanced safety features that may include Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation System, Lane Keeping Assist System, Adaptive Cruise Control, Blind Spot Information System, Rear Cross Traffic Monitor, Forward Collision Warning, and a multi-angle rearview camera.

The exterior showcases bold styling with premium Touring-specific accents, LED headlights and taillights, stylish alloy wheels, body-colour trim, and a commanding presence that looks equally at home on job sites, city streets, and weekend adventures.

For drivers searching for a used Honda Ridgeline Touring for sale on Vancouver Island, this 2023 model offers an exceptional combination of truck capability, family-friendly comfort, advanced technology, and Honda's renowned long-term reliability. It is the ideal choice for active lifestyles, outdoor enthusiasts, and anyone seeking a pickup that excels both on and off the pavement.
